on-activate = '''
  # --- Node dependencies ---
  if [ ! -d node_modules ] || { [ -f package-lock.json ] && [ package-lock.json -nt node_modules ]; }; then
    npm install --silent
  fi

  # --- PostgreSQL cluster + connection wiring ---
  # Ported from scripts/start_dev_db.sh. Per the repo README, postgres runs over

  # fighting over port 5432. Cluster + socket live under $FLOX_ENV_CACHE
  # (machine-local, per-checkout) instead of the repo's target/ tree.
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  export PGSOCKET="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/pg-socket"
  export PGHOST="$PGSOCKET"
  mkdir -p "$PGSOCKET"

  # The socket dir contains '/' chars, so percent-encode it for the libpq URI
  # host component (same trick as start_dev_db.sh). Only '/' needs encoding here.
  ENCODED_SOCKET="${PGSOCKET//\//%2F}"
  export DATABASE_URL="postgres://${PGUSER}@${ENCODED_SOCKET}/${PGDATABASE}"

  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" \
      --username="$PGUSER" \
      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    echo "listen_addresses = ''" >> "$PGDATA/postgresql.conf"
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" \
      -o "-p $PGPORT -k $PGSOCKET -c listen_addresses=''" \
      -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start

    createdb -h "$PGSOCKET" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" "$PGDATABASE"

    fi
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast
  fi
'''

[services.postgres]
command = '''
  exec postgres \
    -D "$PGDATA" \
    -p "$PGPORT" \
    -k "$PGSOCKET" \
    -c listen_addresses=''
'''

      -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start
    until pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -q; do sleep 0.2; done

    -k "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/pg-socket" \

schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

## Install Packages --------------------------------------------------
[install]
nodejs.pkg-path = "nodejs_22"           # engines.node >=22.0.0
postgresql.pkg-path = "postgresql_16"   # pg client + DATABASE_URL (dev datastore)
# jq pinned to 1.8.1: the latest 1.8.2 has no x86_64-darwin build, which would
# break activation on Intel Macs. 1.8.1 is the newest build on all 4 platforms.
jq.pkg-path = "jq"                      # percent-encodes the socket path for DATABASE_URL
jq.version = "1.8.1"


## Environment Variables ---------------------------------------------
[vars]
PGUSER = "orders"
PGDATABASE = "orders_development"
PORT = "3000"


## Activation Hook ---------------------------------------------------
[hook]
on-activate = """
  # --- Node dependencies ---
  if [ ! -d node_modules ] || { [ -f package-lock.json ] && [ package-lock.json -nt node_modules ]; }; then
    npm install --silent
  fi

  # --- Dev PostgreSQL (ported from scripts/start_dev_db.sh) ---
  # The repo runs postgres over a unix socket *inside the repo tree* (not TCP)
  # so several checkouts coexist. The socket path is fixed at
  # target/dev-db-socket because package.json's `db:dump` connects with
  # `-h target/dev-db-socket`. The cluster data itself lives in the Flox cache
  # (machine-local, not committed).
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  export PGSOCKET="$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/target/dev-db-socket"
  mkdir -p "$PGSOCKET"
  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" \
      --username="$PGUSER" \
      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    # Socket-only cluster, matching the repo's postgresql.conf tweaks.
    echo "listen_addresses = ''" >> "$PGDATA/postgresql.conf"
    echo "unix_socket_directories = '$PGSOCKET'" >> "$PGDATA/postgresql.conf"
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -o "-k '$PGSOCKET'" -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start >&2
    until pg_isready -h "$PGSOCKET" -q; do sleep 0.2; done
    createdb -h "$PGSOCKET" -U "$PGUSER" "$PGDATABASE" 2>/dev/null || true
    # Load the checked-in schema snapshot.
    if [ -f db/schema.sql ]; then
      psql -h "$PGSOCKET" -U "$PGUSER" -d "$PGDATABASE" -q -f db/schema.sql >&2
    fi
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast >&2
  fi

  # The socket dir contains '/' characters, so it must be percent-encoded
  # before it can be embedded as the host component of a libpq URI. This is
  # exactly what scripts/start_dev_db.sh emits; the app reads DATABASE_URL.
  ENCODED_SOCKET="$(printf '%s' "$PGSOCKET" | jq -sRr @uri)"
  export DATABASE_URL="postgres://${PGUSER}@${ENCODED_SOCKET}/${PGDATABASE}"
"""


## Services ----------------------------------------------------------
[services.postgres]
command = """
  exec postgres \
    -D "$PGDATA" \
    -k "$PGSOCKET" \
    -c listen_addresses=''
"""

schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

## Install Packages --------------------------------------------------
[install]
# Node runtime — package.json engines.node >=22.0.0
nodejs.pkg-path = "nodejs_22"
# PostgreSQL — the app's leaf datastore (pg client + DATABASE_URL in
# .env.example). Provides the server plus initdb/psql/pg_dump/pg_isready
# used by the service hook and `npm run db:dump`.
postgresql.pkg-path = "postgresql_16"


## Environment Variables ---------------------------------------------
## Match .env.example so a fresh `cp .env.example .env` connects out of the box.
[vars]
PGHOST = "127.0.0.1"
PGPORT = "5432"
PGUSER = "orders"
PGDATABASE = "orders_development"


## Activation Hook ---------------------------------------------------
[hook]
on-activate = """
  # --- Node deps -------------------------------------------------------
  if [ ! -d node_modules ] || { [ -f package-lock.json ] && [ package-lock.json -nt node_modules ]; }; then
    npm install --silent
  fi

  # --- Postgres cluster bootstrap -------------------------------------
  # Cluster lives in the machine-local cache (not the repo tree). The unix
  # socket is placed inside the repo at target/dev-db-socket so that
  # `npm run db:dump` (pg_dump -h target/dev-db-socket) keeps working, while
  # TCP on 127.0.0.1:5432 serves .env.example's DATABASE_URL.
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  export SOCKET_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/target/dev-db-socket"
  mkdir -p "$SOCKET_DIR"

  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" \
      --username="$PGUSER" \
      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" \
      -o "-p $PGPORT -k $SOCKET_DIR -c listen_addresses=$PGHOST" \
      -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start >&2
    until pg_isready -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -q; do sleep 0.2; done
    createdb -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" "$PGDATABASE" >&2
    # Load the checked-in schema snapshot, mirroring start_dev_db.sh.
    if [ -f db/schema.sql ]; then
      psql -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" -d "$PGDATABASE" -q -f db/schema.sql >&2
    fi
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast >&2
  fi
"""


## Services ---------------------------------------------------------
[services.postgres]
command = """
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  export SOCKET_DIR="$FLOX_ENV_PROJECT/target/dev-db-socket"
  mkdir -p "$SOCKET_DIR"
  exec postgres \
    -D "$PGDATA" \
    -p "$PGPORT" \
    -k "$SOCKET_DIR" \
    -c listen_addresses="$PGHOST"
"""
